gloss: good plan; good idea; wise strategy

definitions.gloss: good plan; good idea; wise strategy; good measure
definitions.explanation: A plan, strategy, or course of action that is considered effective and well-thought-out. Often used in the negative to say there is no good solution.

examples.japanese: なかなか{良策|りょうさく}が{見|み}つからない。
examples.english: I can't seem to find a good plan.

examples.japanese: それは{良策|りょうさく}とは{言|い}えない。
examples.english: I wouldn't call that a good idea.

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}を{解消|かいしょう}するための{良策|りょうさく}を{検討|けんとう}しているが、{予算|よさん}の{問題|もんだい}もあり{難航|なんこう}している。
examples.english: We are considering good strategies to relieve traffic congestion, but progress is difficult due to budget issues.

notes:
Composed of {良|りょう} (good) + {策|さく} (plan, strategy). A somewhat formal word often encountered in discussions of policy, business strategy, and problem-solving. Notably common in negative contexts — {良策|りょうさく}がない (there's no good plan) is a frequent pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良策|りょうさく}を{見|み}つける — to find a good plan
- {良策|りょうさく}を{考|かんが}える — to think of a good plan
- {良策|りょうさく}がない — there is no good plan
- {良策|りょうさく}とは{言|い}えない — cannot be called a good plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {妙案|みょうあん} — brilliant idea; more creative, implies cleverness
- {名案|めいあん} — excellent idea; emphasizes the quality of the idea
- {対策|たいさく} — countermeasure; neutral, doesn't imply good or bad
- {方策|ほうさく} — policy, strategy; more formal, used in government/business
